RomanianOfficial1930.focus: Monitorul Oficial nr. 17 bis, 22 Ianuarie 1930, p. 680, Decretul 43 şi tabelul judeţelor

PartiumAdministration.focus: 1732 decree, 1733 enactment: Kraszna, Közép-Szolnok, Kővár under Transylvanian administration

PartiumResearch.focus: Eastern Hungary research pp. 215–217: Partium 1732–1860 transition; 1876 restructure

HungarianCounties.focus: 1911 Britannica, Hungary Administrative Divisions: counties in Hungarian Kingdom after 1876, outside Transylvanian principality

TransnistriaGovernorate.focus: V. Stănică, Administraţia teritoriului României în timpul celui de-al doilea război mondial, p. 111: 13 judeţe in governorate of Transnistria incl. Iugastru, Moghilău, Tulcin

ChernivtsiArchives.focus: Chernivtsi regional State Archives: Chernivtsi oblast formed as Ukrainian SSR oblast 7 Aug 1940

TranscarpathiaCSR.focus: Czechoslovak province 1920–1938, Czechoslovakia absent in OHM

TranscarpathiaUkrSSR.focus: Transcarpathian oblast creation / 1946 Ukrainian SSR legislation

IzmailAkkerman.focus: Akkerman region and transformation to Izmail, part of Ukrainian SSR

USSRMoldavia.focus: US Foreign Relations 1940: MSSR formed from portions of Bessarabia / MASSR and USSR

BukovinaGalicia.focus: 1849 separation from Galicia, 1861 provincial autonomy; do not infer district as child of duchy

BanatVoivodina.focus: 1849 voivodina created as direct imperial administrative territory, not child of Banatul Timișoarei

PrincipalityContext.focus: Historical administrative scope of Hungarian Crown; not evidence that earlier principalities were its direct subunits

methodology: Each group inventoried with all OHM relation IDs, source windows, per-case verdict, candidate absent parent and documentary references. A contextual citation does NOT certify a pending direct parent. A qualified parent link is admitted only via the separate date-scoped parentage register. No temporal interval extrapolation and no geometry change.
